about: Recurring cast of the experiment log Shorts (format "xplog"). Drawn by shorts/design_kit/xplog-kit.jsx (XLChar who=<id> mood=…) — never redraw a cast member by hand. The narrator speaks to the viewer as "you"; the cast member is the viewer's stand-in on screen. People the viewer texts or meets (Sam, a boss, a date) stay grey avatars (XLAvatar). Append each episode to the character's history.
style: Thick ink outlines, big round heads with round white eyes, navy striped walls, cream UI cards, yellow accent #FFC93C, red #E5484D for alerts. HUD on top, one wide panel, sentence caption. Pictures: shorts/styles/xplog/.
